searchText: Hello folks, I have lost my mnemonics and cant change my withdrawal credentials. Is there any chance that in future, devs will considers this and adjust the process for validator exit and funds withdrawal. i have the validator keys and and passwords, but cant find the mnemonics. After 2.5 years of contributing to the blockchain, I got stuck with this. There many others like me. Would it be possible to send the funds to another address in the consensus layer after exiting validator duties. From there, with the new address and known mnemonics, the bls can be changed. I know it sounds stupid. Sorry for that. I am not a dev, just an excited ethereum fan who locked his funds 2.5 years ago. 😦 Such a change would create a significant increased security risk for validators because it would mean that if someone acquires the validator keys they would be able to steal the stake. Validator keys are very hot, and the withdraw address is meant to be cold. It would be bad to give more power than necessary to the hot keys. I got that point. I hope there is another way to get the funds in future.
